options.name: Compact daily guide
options.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create ONE high fidelity redesigned mobile HOME screen for Cathopedia, using the attached screenshot as the brand and content reference. This is a new design proposal, not a live screenshot. ONE centered full phone only, straight-on, slender silver Android phone border with centered camera hole, on quiet near-black background, full device visible with small even margins. Tall portrait composition, large readable mobile UI. Cross-platform native mobile style. Retain Cathopedia's deep forest green #071B13 background, dark green surfaces #17392C, muted antique gold #C8AB45, warm ivory #F3ECD8 serif headings, clean cream sans-serif body copy, gold devotional emblem, painterly Catholic imagery. The app identity and atmosphere must match the reference, no generic blue/purple UI. Consistent 20dp horizontal margins, 16-24dp section spacing, refined corners and thin gold details. Avoid giant green framed cards below the readings. Smaller modules must still have comfortable tap targets. No tiny text, placeholder words, clipped paragraphs, progress/streak statistics, invented completion states, promotional banners or excessive decorative boxes. Keep portraits sharp, fully visible and uncrowded. Bottom navigation: retain FIVE small gold circular medallions for Home (church), Explore (compass), Rosary (beads), Settings (gear), Search (magnifier), with Home selected, on a restrained dark green dock. The dock is below content with generous separation; NEVER overlap or obscure content. White system status time 2:14, signal, battery, and bottom gesture indicator. Keep the same frame, palette, typography and bottom dock across all proposals.
Top area: compact Cathopedia header with devotional emblem, large serif 'Cathopedia', gold 'Knowledge · Faith · Tradition', atmospheric St Peter's dome artwork quietly on the upper right, and a small 'Ordinary time' label. Do not spend half the screen on the header.
Keep a single main 'Today's readings' card in the upper-middle screen: serif 'Weekday'; readable rows 'First reading' / 'Galatians 4:22–24, 26–27, 31–5:1' and 'Gospel' / 'Luke 11:29–32'. Include a visible short scripture preview labeled 'Verse of the day · Luke 11:29': 'A sign shall not be given it, but the sign of Jonas the prophet.' with subtle 'Douay–Rheims' attribution and a discreet gold 'Read full readings →' action. Open Bible and candle painting faintly on the right without hurting text contrast. This is a preview excerpt for the concept, not new scripture copy. Let the readings remain the primary card, with generous readable type rather than shrinking font sizes to cram in modules. All text must be spelled accurately. Use 12 October as the example date, Carlo Acutis as the saint, Andrew as the example recently viewed apostle. Show all modules described below within the full phone above the dock.
Specific composition A — COMPACT DAILY GUIDE: replace the original tall saints and continue-reading boxes with different compact structures. Under the readings card, a cream serif heading 'Saint of the day' and the small date '12 October'. ONE compact horizontal saint row about 80dp tall, with a clearly visible small framed portrait of Carlo Acutis on the LEFT, then 'Carlo Acutis' in ivory serif, just ONE secondary line 'A young witness to the Eucharist', and a small gold chevron. No giant biography box. Next a heading 'A moment of prayer' with TWO equal modest horizontal shortcuts side by side: a small warm gold sunrise icon and 'Morning offering', a gold rosary-beads icon and 'Pray the Rosary'. Keep the shortcuts light and compact with fine outlines, not large square blocks. Finally a flat compact 'Continue reading' row: 40dp portrait of apostle Andrew, text 'Andrew' with secondary 'Apostle', and right arrow, separated by a faint hairline rather than a giant outer card. Optional compact 'Browse saints & churches →' text at bottom if space allows. The screen must feel calm, familiar, useful and visually lighter than the source. Strong editorial hierarchy, warm green and gold, clear portrait and touch targets. No option labels or annotation outside the phone.

First row: 48dp framed Carlo Acutis portrait at left, serif 'Meet Carlo Acutis', secondary 'Saint of the day · 12 October', subtle arrow at right.
